recovery.method: One bounded projected analytic-HVP Newton-CG continuation
recovery.acceptance: Unprojected L2 residual strictly decreases; Pi <= previous Pi + 100 eps max(|U|,|Pi|,1e-30). No duplicate coordinates accepted.
recovery.contact: Abort recovery for Ucontact >1e-24 J; HVP is existing noncontact tangent

scope: One main solve from zero A0, at most one same-2Pa recovery; no other optimizer/load/specimen. Numerical accepted states are not physical time.
